tasks.label: Build Chrome Extensions
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Copy-Item tooltip.js automatic/; Copy-Item docs-tooltip.js automatic/; Copy-Item tooltip.js manual/; Copy-Item docs-tooltip.js manual/; if (Test-Path extension) { Remove-Item extension -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path extension_manual) { Remove-Item extension_manual -Recurse -Force }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path extension -Force | Out-Null; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path extension_manual -Force | Out-Null; 'manifest.json','content_script.js','tooltip.js','docs-tooltip.js','popup.html','popup.js','background.js' | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item automatic/\$_ extension/ }; 'manifest.json','tooltip.js','docs-tooltip.js','popup.html','popup.js','background.js' | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item manual/\$_ extension_manual/ }; Copy-Item translate.js extension/; Copy-Item translate.js extension_manual/; Copy-Item mappings extension/ -Recurse; Copy-Item mappings extension_manual/ -Recurse; Get-ChildItem shift*.png | ForEach-Object { Copy-Item $_.Name extension/; Copy-Item $_.Name extension_manual/ }; Compress-Archive -Path extension -DestinationPath extension.zip -Force; Compress-Archive -Path extension_manual -DestinationPath extension_manual.zip -Force; Remove-Item automatic/tooltip.js; Remove-Item automatic/docs-tooltip.js; Remove-Item manual/tooltip.js; Remove-Item manual/docs-tooltip.js"
